credit.definition: Money arriving in the account, such as a salary or a refund. On a statement it is usually shown with a plus sign.
credit.example: The credit of 1200 $ on the 15th is my salary.

lts_singleness.definition: The situation of being without a romantic partner, seen as a general condition rather than one person's story.
lts_singleness.example: Long-term singleness has its own vocabulary, and its own pressures.

mind_evidence.definition: A fact that supports a claim, so that the claim does not rest on opinion alone.
mind_evidence.example: The temperature log is evidence that the pump ran hot.

protein.definition: The building material of your body. It helps you grow and keeps you full for longer.
protein.example: Eggs are full of protein, so they are a good snack.

war_offensive.definition: The side that attacks; in the phrase the offensive, the direction of the action.
war_offensive.example: The offensive stopped when the supplies ran out.
